title: The Typewriter of Port Mahon
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Rafael Vane, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
